messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] option "drop" of lodint
parts:
> The option "drop" of lodint, instead of the values 1.5,1.8 and 2.0, Can I use the other values, for example 0.5, 1.0 ?

You can use any value, but with smaller values, the coverage is lower.

> In my case, after the permutation test 1000 times, with alpha=0.2, I got the LOD threshold 2.17
> and then if I use the value 1.5 by defaut, the confidence interval is
> chr pos lod
> cSakl0H.loc38 Sakl0H 43,2364 0,7576139
> cSakl0H.loc612 Sakl0H 617,2364 2,3362143
> Sakl0H 1792860 Sakl0H 717,1440 0,6546758
>
> it's really wide, because the LOD score isn't big enough, so I took 1.0, it became better
> chr pos lod
> Sakl0H 1435792 Sakl0H 574,3168 1,270976
> cSakl0H.loc612 Sakl0H 617,2364 2,3362143
> Sakl0H 1667311 Sakl0H 666,9244 1,195609
>
> Is that right? because I think it doesn't make sense

Why doesn't it make sense?

karl

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] option "drop" of lodint
parts:
I generally use 1.5; you might increase to 1.8 for an intercross.

See Manichaikul et al. (2006) Genetics 174:481-489
http://www.biostat.wisc.edu/~kbroman/publications/qtlboot.pdf

karl
